parameters.name: Collection
parameters.description:
The name of the document collection.

> You can call the [CreateDocumentCollection](~~2618448~~) operation to create a document collection and call the [ListDocumentCollections](~~2618452~~) operation to query a list of document collections.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance for which vector engine optimization is enabled.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The ID of the document upload job. You can call the `UploadDocumentAsync` operation to obtain the job ID.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description:
The name of the namespace for tenant isolation. Default value: public.

> You can call the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation to create a namespace and call the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation to query a list of namespaces.

parameters.name: NamespacePassword
parameters.description:
The password of the namespace.

> The value of this parameter is specified when you call the CreateNamespace operation.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb get-upload-document-job --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --namespace mynamespace --collection document --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace-password testpassword --job-id bf8f7bc4-9276-44f7-9c22-1d06edc8dfd1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb GetUploadDocumentJob --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --Collection document --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NamespacePassword testpassword --Namespace mynamespace --JobId 'bf8f7bc4-9276-44f7-9c22-1d06edc8dfd1'
